thread:
liam: Following up on the RDI-4021 postmortem: we need a short, runnable regression suite + an automated chaos drill to prevent the same fallback+tokenization regression. Link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/RDI-4021
kelly: I'll own the prompt-set and quick CI repro. Plan: small JSON suite that covers (a) role-tokenization drift under fallback, (b) stop-seq truncation case. Targeting small runs so CI stays fast.
anya: I'll add the failing prompts to eval-harness and include a KV-cache warmup stage. We should gate the canary deploy on the eval not regressing.
sanjay: I'll build a k6 ramp/spike that emulates production: baseline 180 rps with 95th at ~220, 60s spike to 800 rps, and a node-loss scenario where 2 GPUs are removed mid-run. I'll wire results to the postmortem ticket.
kelly: Proposed timelines: prompt-set + unit checks by Thu EOD, CI-integrated regression job by next Tue. Owner: @kelly.
liam: Sanjay, can you target Friday for the chaos drill runbook and exec so SRE can join? Owner: @sanjay. Add clear abort criteria.
sanjay: Will do. Creating ticket RDI-4112 (chaos: fallback + node loss) and linking here. Runbook will include: pre-checks, KVM warmup, spike, node drain, verification steps, and postmortem capture commands.
anya: For eval alerting: add a metric for token-distribution drift (top-k shift) and a regression rate alarm when stop-seq failures > 1%. Also add a CI badge that fails builds if the regression suite has >0 fails.
kelly: Example minimal k6 snippet for the spike phase:
```js
import http from 'k6/http';
export default function() {
  http.post(__ENV.GEN_URL, JSON.stringify({prompt: 'role: assistant\nuser: hi'}), {headers: {'Content-Type':'application/json'}})
}
```
liam: Rotation question: who triages regressed evals when CI fails? We should have a short on-call rotation.
kelly: Suggestion: eng-ml weekdays 09-17, eng-platform nights/weekends. I'll stub a rota doc and add to the postmortem follow-ups.
sanjay: I'll also add a synthetic run job in our load pipeline that runs the chaos scenario monthly and after each major model rollout.
incident-bot: Created RDI-4112 and linked to RDI-4021. Assigned to sanjay. Due date 2026-04-10.
anya: Recap of owners/dates: kelly: prompt-set + CI integration (due Thu EOD); sanjay: chaos drill + load profile + runbook (due 2026-04-10); anya: eval harness changes + alerting + canary gate (due next Tue); liam: publish rotation doc and update postmortem follow-ups (due Mon). I'll update RDI-4021 with links when tickets are ready.
liam: Nice. Please add progress comments to the respective tickets and ping me if timelines slip. :thumbsup:
